mapper.select: SELECT id, name, name_en AS nameEn, description, asset_type AS assetType, rebalance_cycle AS rebalanceCycle, params::text AS params, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_strategy WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id

SELECT id, name, name_en AS nameEn, description, asset_type AS assetType, rebalance_cycle AS rebalanceCycle, params::text AS params, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_strategy WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, name_en AS nameEn, description, asset_type AS assetType, rebalance_cycle AS rebalanceCycle, params::text AS params, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt FROM quant_strategy WHERE name_en = #{nameEn} AND is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_strategy (name, name_en, description, asset_type, rebalance_cycle, params, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{nameEn}, #{description}, #{assetType}, #{rebalanceCycle}, #{params}::jsonb, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (name_en) DO NOTHING
